description: This file is a PHP class extending ViewDetail, used to customize the display and behavior of the Campaigns module's detail view in SuiteCRM. It manages subpanel visibility, button states, and dynamic content based on campaign type.

classes.name: CampaignsViewDetail
classes.description: A view class customizing the Campaigns module's detail view, overriding methods for display and preDisplay to modify UI elements and behavior based on campaign type.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the view and disabling subpanel display by default.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Pre-display hook adjusting module strings and ensuring subpanels stay hidden for this view.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Main display method configuring subpanels, buttons, currency display, and handling specific campaign types, including subpanel filtering based on campaign context.
